title: Lesson
description: What the use of a resource taught: a correction, a note, a gap an agent saw. Gathered with consent, it is data, never an instruction; its owner keeps it — it becomes a test case — or drops it (doctrine D-053).

source.description: correction: a person corrected a draft. note: a person noted it. agent: an agent saw a gap.

proposal.description: What could change in the resource.

case.description: The situation it came from, which becomes a test case if kept.

consent.description: The person agreed to share it; nothing confidential travels unless generalized.
